passage: The genomics revolution finally let scientists see, at a molecular level, just how powerfully touch affects plants.
Studying the genes of Arabidopsis thaliana, the laboratory workhorse of plant biology, researchers found that touch alone set off a dramatic response.
That response reached deep into the plant's hormones and gene expression and could sharply hold back its growth.
In their experiment, the scientists gently stroked the plants with soft paintbrushes and then read their genetic reactions.
Within just thirty minutes of being touched, fully ten percent of the plant's genome had been altered.
Clearly, the plant was reorganizing its priorities to deal with the disturbance.
It was pulling energy away from the demanding task of growing taller.
Touched again and again, the plant cut its upward growth rate by as much as thirty percent.
choices: how physical touch triggers genetic responses that suppress plant growth
how the genomics revolution transformed modern medical research
why Arabidopsis is the most common plant in the natural world
how plants compete with one another for sunlight and water
why gardeners should water their plants on a fixed schedule
theme.explanation_ko: 접촉이 식물의 호르몬·유전자 발현에 극적인 반응을 일으켜 성장을 크게 억제한다는 내용. '접촉이 성장을 억제하는 유전적 반응을 촉발한다'가 주제이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ②유전체학과 의학, ③애기장대의 흔함, ④빛·물 경쟁, ⑤급수 일정은 본문 초점이 아니다.

passage: We tend to imagine plants as passive things that simply sit still and grow, but that picture is misleading.
Genomic studies of Arabidopsis thaliana reveal that a plant reacts to being touched far more dramatically than we assumed.
Within thirty minutes of a light touch, about ten percent of its genome was altered.
The plant was clearly rerouting energy away from the hard work of getting taller in order to handle the disturbance.
Touched repeatedly, it cut its upward growth by as much as thirty percent.
We should therefore stop treating plants as insensible and recognize that they actively sense and respond to their surroundings.
What looks like stillness is in fact a constant stream of hidden molecular decisions.
Taking that sensitivity seriously changes how we ought to study and handle plants.
choices: 우리는 식물을 무감각한 존재로 여기지 말고 능동적으로 감각·반응하는 존재로 인식해야 한다.
정원사는 식물을 가능한 한 자주 만져 성장을 촉진해야 한다.
유전체학은 의학보다 식물학에서 더 큰 성과를 거두었다.
식물 연구는 반드시 애기장대만을 대상으로 삼아야 한다.
식물은 빛이 부족할 때만 성장 속도를 늦춘다.
claim.explanation_ko: 접촉만으로도 식물이 유전자 수준에서 극적으로 반응하므로, 식물을 무감각한 존재가 아니라 능동적으로 감각·반응하는 존재로 보아야 한다는 주장. ①이 정답.
claim.distractor_ko: ②자주 만지기 권장(본문은 접촉이 성장 억제), ③④⑤는 핵심 주장과 무관하다.

passage: Modern genomic tools have shown how deeply touch reaches into a plant's inner workings.
In Arabidopsis thaliana, a gentle touch quietly set off a dramatic shift in hormones and gene expression.
Within thirty minutes, ten percent of the plant's genome had changed.
The plant was reorganizing its priorities and pulling energy away from growing taller.
Researchers had simply stroked the plants with soft paintbrushes before measuring these reactions.
Repeated touching slowed the plant's upward growth by up to thirty percent.
Touch, in other words, is not trivial to a plant; it is a major signal.
And the plant's chief reply to that signal is to hold back its own growth.
choices: 접촉은 식물의 유전자 반응을 일으켜 성장을 크게 억제한다.
애기장대는 다른 어떤 식물보다 빠르게 자란다.
유전체학 혁명은 식물보다 동물 연구를 더 발전시켰다.
식물은 부드러운 붓으로 만질 때만 반응한다.
식물의 호르몬은 빛의 양에 따라서만 변한다.
gist.explanation_ko: 접촉이 유전자·호르몬 반응을 통해 식물의 성장을 억제한다는 것이 요지. ①이 정답.
gist.distractor_ko: ②성장 속도 비교, ③동물 연구, ④붓에만 반응, ⑤빛에만 좌우는 근거 없다.

passage: Thanks to genomics, scientists can now watch, at the molecular level, how strongly touch acts on plants.
In Arabidopsis thaliana, a mere touch triggered a dramatic change in hormones and gene expression.
Ten percent of the genome shifted within half an hour of contact.
To cope with the disturbance, the plant rerouted energy away from the labor of growing taller.
Stroked over and over with soft brushes, it slowed its upward growth by up to thirty percent.
What feels to us like a harmless brush is, to the plant, a serious event.
Its genome answers that event by quietly applying the brakes to growth.
Touch, it turns out, is a language plants take very seriously.
choices: A Single Touch: How Contact Slows a Plant's Growth
Genomics and the Future of Human Medicine
Arabidopsis: The Fastest-Growing Plant on Earth
Why Plants Need Sunlight More Than Water
The Art of Painting With Soft Brushes
title.explanation_ko: 접촉이 식물의 성장을 늦춘다는 핵심을 압축한 ①이 제목.
title.distractor_ko: ②의학, ③성장 속도, ④빛·물, ⑤붓 그림은 초점이 아니다.

summary.summary_template: Genomic studies show that being __(A)__ triggers such strong genetic changes in a plant that it ends up __(B)__ its own upward growth.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 흐름상 빈칸에 들어갈 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 단어를 본문에 근거하여 쓰시오.
